gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured grey on Drawing No. KH 2857, commencing at its junction with Jats Incline adjoining Good Hope School, running in a north-westerly direction for about 45 m, then turning westward for about 240 m and continuing in a south-westerly direction for about 60 m.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路在 KH 2857 號圖則上以灰色標明，起點在鄰接德望學校之扎山道交界處，向西北伸展約四十五米，轉向西伸展約二百四十米，然後向西南伸展約六十米。
